name: The Suitor
description: A visiting young lad who comes courting and quietly observes the family's performance.
visualPrompt: A modest young man in simple country clothes, slightly travel-worn boots, attentive expression and calm posture, standing politely inside a poor farmhouse, watching the household with restrained curiosity

name: The Farmer
description: The father who tries to look well-to-do by cleaning with his one new sweater sleeve and hiding the other arm.
visualPrompt: A gaunt middle-aged farmer with weathered face and rough hands, wearing a worn sweater with one noticeably new, clean sleeve; he wipes a wooden bench with the new sleeve while keeping his other arm tucked behind his back, determined expression

name: The Farmer's Wife
description: The mother who shows off her single new shoe by kicking and prying at furniture as if tidying.
visualPrompt: A tired but spirited woman in patched rustic clothing, one foot wearing a bright new shoe and the other a worn old one; she nudges a stool and chair aside with the new shoe, chin lifted as if making excuses for the mess

name: The Daughter
description: Their girl who displays her new cap by only poking her head in and nodding as if helping.
visualPrompt: A young farm girl with a clean, new cap contrasting her otherwise plain, mended dress; she peeks through a doorway, nodding briskly left and right as if directing chores from afar, slightly smug expression
